title: An AI-Powered Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) tool
summary: AI4Africa proposes speech-to-speech assistance for people with communication disabilities and names Limi Hospital as a testbed.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The proposed augmentative and alternative communication tool would transform difficult-to-understand speech into clearer output. Limi Hospital is named as a testbed, while the technical development is described as future work. The intended benefit is greater communication independence. Restored communication for a user remains undocumented.
purpose: Support communication for people with speech disabilities.

ratings.reason: Limi Hospital is a planned testbed for the proposed AAC tool. Restored communication for an individual remains undocumented.
Social inclusion is a projected effect of communication support.
